name: Aniyome Oyako
source: The protagonist fails his entrance exams and moves to Tokyo to attend a prep school in the city, living with his brother's family. His brother and sister-in-law warmly welcome him into their home. As he begins his new life, he becomes close to his kind sister-in-law, and his feelings for her begin to grow. Then, her mother and sister begin to visit as well...
translation: 主人公考试落榜，搬到东京上补习学校，住进哥哥一家。哥哥和嫂子热情地欢迎他到家中。开始新生活后，他与温柔的嫂子关系亲近起来，也渐渐对她产生感情。随后，她的母亲和妹妹也开始来访……
